page.layout: One column of running text; running head with page number at the top. No margin notes, no footnotes. Signature "d 2" at the foot on the left of the last line.

main_text.p: perius dicebamus, Iurispru- dentiam profiteri olim in cu- iusuis, qui modò ingenio ac doctrinæ fuæ confideret, arbitrio potestateque fuisse. At vero posterioribus tempo- ribus Augustus Cæsar totam hanc profitendæ Iuris- prudentiæ rationem immu- tauit. non enim arbitrio cu- iusque potestatem illam per misit: sed cum (ut credi par est) propter multorum indignitatem, eam sibi temere scientiam arrogantium, flos ille veteris dignitatis exarui- set, constituit, ut nemo, nisi qui à se auctoritatem illa ac- cepisset, respondendi ius ha- beret.

page.notes: Long s rendered as f in the scan (e.g. "iufuis", "poteftate", "fuiffe") is normalised to plain s. Doubtful: "iusuis" in line 2 and "tauit" in the immu- line are read from the scan; the word "indignitatem" is written whole because the line end shows no printed hyphen. The "d 2" signature is on the same line as "beret." and is placed in bottom_margin.
